snippet.title: HE BEAT HER. (Game) : Ludum Dare 39 Timelapse
snippet.description:
Play it on itch.io (https://zephyo.itch.io/he-beat-her), Game Jolt (http://gamejolt.com/games/he-beat-her/273009), or Ludum Dare (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/39/he-beat-her).

1:38 Art
18:29 Music
21:30 Polish

Sorry this isn't a speedpaint!! But this is my first ludum dare; i'm super proud and I thought this vid might help some people, so I wanted to share it :)
